```{r Load clean_names_lowercase function}
clean_names_lowercase <- function(x) {

  x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  x <- stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII")

  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    trimws()
}
```

# STEP 2: Add OHI region details to the GCMP_nrsi.data_raw based on lat-long details

```{r Loading in OHI regions and buffer shape files}
# Read in OHI region boundaries
ohi_regions <- st_read(here("spatial", "ohi_regions", "goc_ohi_rgns.shp")) %>% 
  st_make_valid()

# Quick plot:
OHI_Region_plot<- ggplot(ohi_regions) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = rgn_id)) +
  theme_bw()

OHI_Region_plot

```

```{r Merge rgn_id to NRSI data}
# Convert longitude and latitude to spatial points
NRSI_sf <- st_as_sf(
  GCMP_nrsi.data_raw,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

# Check that both datasets have a defined CRS
st_crs(NRSI_sf)
st_crs(ohi_regions)

stopifnot(!is.na(st_crs(NRSI_sf)))
stopifnot(!is.na(st_crs(ohi_regions)))

# Transform sites to the CRS of the OHI regions
NRSI_sf <- st_transform(NRSI_sf, st_crs(ohi_regions))

# Verify that both datasets now have identical CRS
stopifnot(st_crs(NRSI_sf) == st_crs(ohi_regions))

# Perform spatial join:
NRSI_Data0 <- st_join(
  NRSI_sf,
  ohi_regions %>% select(rgn_id),
  join = st_within
)

NRSI_Data0 <- NRSI_Data0 %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

dim(NRSI_Data0)
# 1630 obs.,  10 vars.

table(NRSI_Data0$rgn_id)
# Region_2 Region_3 Region_4 Region_6 Region_7 Region_9 
#       95       71     1391       18        2       53 

```

```{r Load in CEDO Rocky Reef Sargassum layer}
CEDO_rocky.reef_data <- st_read("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/Hem_data/goc_habitat_data/Arrecife rocoso/Arrecife rocoso.shp") %>% st_zm()

plot(st_geometry(CEDO_rocky.reef_data))

# Match hem data to OHI CRS
CEDO_rocky.reef_data <- st_transform(
  CEDO_rocky.reef_data,
  st_crs(ohi_regions)
)

```

```{r Assign the rocky-reef extent to each OHI region}
# Assign the rocky-reef  extent to each OHI region:
ROKR_Current_Extent <- st_intersection(
  st_transform(CEDO_rocky.reef_data, st_crs(ohi_regions)),
  ohi_regions
) %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    area_est_byCEDO.2025_ha = sum(rocky_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    geometry = st_union(geometry),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    area_est_byCEDO.2025_ha = round(area_est_byCEDO.2025_ha, 2),
    area_est_byCEDO.2025_km2 = round(area_est_byCEDO.2025_ha / 100, 2),
    year = 2025
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()
# 9 obs, 3 vars.

```

# STEP 3: Compute NRSI_Data per region ------------------------------
Scores = average NSRI score by OHI region

```{r Summarize NRSI and join Region_Key}

colnames(NRSI_Data0)

NRSI_Data<- NRSI_Data0 %>%
  group_by(year, rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_NRSI = mean(nrsi_01, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_reefs = n_distinct(reef, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(rgn_id, year, mean_NRSI, n_reefs)

dim(NRSI_Data)
# 55 obs., 4 vars.

table(NRSI_Data$rgn_id)
# Region_2 Region_3 Region_4 Region_6 Region_7 Region_9 
#        9        9       28        5        1        3

```

```{r Gapfill NRSI_Data0}

# First, expand the NRSI dataframe to include one row per year per region, even if that region has no data: 
NRSI_Data <- NRSI_Data %>%
  complete(
    rgn_id = c(paste0("Region_", 1:9)),
    year = full_seq(year, 1)
  )  %>%
  left_join(
    Region_Key,
    by= c("rgn_id")
  )

dim(NRSI_Data)
# 252 obs., 5 vars.

table(NRSI_Data$rgn_id)
# Region_1 Region_2 Region_3 Region_4 Region_5 Region_6 Region_7 Region_8 Region_9 
#       28       28       28       28       28       28       28       28       28

```

```{r Gapfilling}
# Gapfill missing years and NRSI scores using the zoo package:
NRSI_Data_gapfilled <- NRSI_Data %>%

  # Fill variables that don't change within a region
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  fill(rgn_name, .direction = "downup") %>%
  mutate(
    provenance = if_else(
      is.na(mean_NRSI),
      "gapfilled",
      "observed"
    ),
    
    # Interpolate the missing NRSI values
    mean_NRSI = na.approx(
      mean_NRSI,
      x = year,
      na.rm = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# 252 obs., 6 vars.

```

# STEP 4: Generate ROKR_Current_Status ------------------------------

DECISION POINT: Reference point is equal to the highest NRSI value ever observed

```{r Calculate the Rocky Reef reference point}
# ROK_ref_point<- max(ROKR_Current_Status$mean_NRSI[ROKR_Current_Status$provenance=="observed"], na.rm= TRUE)
# # 0.6034904
```

```{r Calculate NRSI 3-year running mean}
# Calculate ROKR_Current_Status as the 3-year running mean of mean_NRSI per region.

ROKR_Current_Status0 <- NRSI_Data_gapfilled %>%
  arrange(rgn_id, year) %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_NRSI_3yr = rollapply(
      mean_NRSI,
      width = 3,
      FUN = mean,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      fill = NA,
      align = "right"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

dim(ROKR_Current_Status0)
# 252 obs., 7 vars. 

# Calculate original ROKR_current_status

ROKR_Current_Status0 <- ROKR_Current_Status0 %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  mutate(
  # Calculate the Rocky Reef (ROK) score as the 3-year running mean divided by the reference point x 100:
  # ROK_score_raw = (mean_NRSI_3yr / ROK_ref_point) * 100 **NOT DOING THIS ANYMORE - Nov 2026**
    ROKR_current_status = round(mean_NRSI * 100, 2),
    ROKR_include_exclude = case_when(
      sum(provenance == "observed", na.rm = TRUE) >= 5 ~ "INCLUDE",
      TRUE ~ "EXCLUDE"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

dim(ROKR_Current_Status0)
# 252 obs., 9 vars. 

```

```{r Clean up ROKR_Current_Status0}
colnames(ROKR_Current_Status)

ROKR_Current_Status <- ROKR_Current_Status0 %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    ROKR_current_status = case_when(
      ROKR_include_exclude == "EXCLUDE" ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ ROKR_current_status
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year,
         provenance, n_reefs, mean_NRSI,
         ROKR_current_status, ROKR_include_exclude)

dim(ROKR_Current_Status)
# 252 obs., 8 vars. 

# Make sure there is an observation for every region:

ROKR_Current_Status <- ROKR_Current_Status %>%
  group_by(rgn_name, rgn_id) %>%
  complete(
    year = min(year, na.rm = TRUE):max(year, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(rgn_id, year)

dim(ROKR_Current_Status)
# 252 obs., 8 vars. 

```

## METHOD B

```{r Calculate ROKR_Trend using METHOD B}
# METHOD B: 
# See GitHub issue, Oct 7 2026, for more details: https://github.com/OHI-GOC/OHI_GOC_issues/issues/127#issuecomment-6041025924
# slope = fit a linear model: lm(area ~ year), grab the slope estimate
# trend_pct_year <- (1 + slope/earliest_area_in_lm)

# Pull the most recent year and the comparison year:
most_recent_year = max(ROKR_Current_Status$year, na.rm = TRUE)

lm_start_year <- min(
  ROKR_Current_Status$year[
    ROKR_Current_Status$provenance == "observed" &
    ROKR_Current_Status$year < most_recent_year &
    ROKR_Current_Status$year >= most_recent_year - 10 &
    ROKR_Current_Status$year <= most_recent_year - 5
  ],
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Keep a complete list of regions
all_regions <- ROKR_Current_Status %>%
  distinct(rgn_id, ROKR_include_exclude)

# Calculate linear models where observed data exist
colnames(ROKR_Current_Status)

ROKR_area_lm <- ROKR_Current_Status %>%
  filter(
    year >= lm_start_year,
    year <= most_recent_year,
    provenance == "observed"
  ) %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    model = list(
      if (n_distinct(year) >= 2) {
        lm(mean_NRSI ~ year, data = pick(everything()))
      } else {
        NULL
      }
    ),
    lm_start_year = min(year),
    lm_end_year = max(year),
    lm_start_area = mean_NRSI[year == min(year)][1],
    lm_end_area = mean_NRSI[year == max(year)][1],
    n_years = n_distinct(year),
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    slope = sapply(model, function(x) {
      if (is.null(x)) NA_real_ else coef(x)[["year"]]
    }),
    p_value = sapply(model, function(x) {
      if (is.null(x)) NA_real_ else summary(x)$coefficients["year", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    }),
    trend_pct_year = round((slope / lm_start_area) * 100, 2)
  )

# Join results back to all regions
ROKR_area_lm <- all_regions %>%
  left_join(ROKR_area_lm, by = "rgn_id")

```

```{r Clean up to save ROKR_Trend}
colnames(ROKR_area_lm)
 
ROKR_Trend<- ROKR_area_lm%>%
  select(rgn_id, 
         ROKR_include_exclude,
         lm_start_year,
         lm_end_year,
         lm_start_area,
         lm_end_area,
         lm_slope= slope,
         n_obs,
         p_value,
         trend= trend_pct_year) %>%
  mutate(
    trend_method = "Method B: linear model on last ~10 years of data"
  )
# 9 obs., 11 vars.

```

## Save ROKR_Trend
```{r Save ROKR_Trend}
write.csv(ROKR_Trend,
          file= "/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/_habitats/HAB_rocky_reefs/ROK_outputs/ROKR_Trend_1.1_Nov082026.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```
